text:
mika: quick sync — prototyping a probe-budget controller + compact runtime hints. goal: cap probes_per_request (~<=6) while keeping correctness for tiered SLAs.
raj: nice. how does this play with runtime-side hinting?
mika: two-tier flow: runtime hint = cheap coarse prune; probe-budget = caps candidate set before probes. budget computed per-request: base_budget * tenant_multiplier, adjusted by recent_success_rate and cache_hits.
emily: worry: bursty tenants may get throttled and lose hedging.
mika: add `allow_huge_budget` flag for internal/high-priority tokens; hedging requests can bypass budget but consume `hedge_quota`. quota enforced cluster-wide.
tran: how do we detect budget-caused correctness loss?
raj: metric: `exhaustive_fallthroughs` when budget trims all validated candidates. threshold 0.1% -> rollback. also `false_positive_filter` when runtime+budget removed the only valid compiled route.
emily: simulation plan?
mika: replay 72h real traffic in shadow mode: runtime emits what-it-would-have-done; budget enforced but probes still run. collect probes_per_request, budget_hits, downstream_latency_delta, cost_delta, false_positive_filter.
tran: config/versioning: compact hint proto must be versioned and signed. add fields: hint_schema_v, snapshot_id, delta_seq. runtime rejects unknown schema or invalid deltas.
raj: deltas help bandwidth but need robust verification. if delta apply fails -> runtime requests full snapshot and uses conservative admit.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: canary must have 100% trace sampling and `budget_shadow_mode` for 48h before enforcement.
emily: debug ergonomics: include `debug` flag in POST to return full candidate list in shadow runs, and a protected `/debug/route_lookup` API for oncall. logs should include decision_signature, snapshot_version, reason_codes.
mika: sample API for RFC:
```
POST /v1/runtime/evaluate_hint
body: {"tenant":"t-42","model":"ornis-x","sla":"p95-200ms","region":"eu-west","hint_schema_v":1}
resp: {"candidates":["r3","r7"],"reason_codes":["region_match","tier_ok"],"snapshot_id":"s-2026-03-20","schema_v":1}
```
raj: add `budget` field in response so callers know the probe cap applied.
mika: done. rollout: shadow -> small canary tenants -> hedged canary -> broader canary -> global. fail-open if snapshot mismatch, fail-closed only behind kill-switch opt-in.
tran: add hysteresis and min-window to avoid probe oscillation; config `budget.hysteresis_ms`.
emily: infra reuse: tie runtime hints to existing probe cache keys so we don't duplicate lookups. if cache hit -> budget reduced. open infra ticket if needed.
deploy-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4910 "probe-budget-cache-integration". https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-4910
raj: good. also include `white_list` for sensitive tenants to skip budget/hints.
mika: will include in RFC with dashboard mockups and gating thresholds. aiming for arch sync next Tuesday.
emily: thanks — let's keep shadow running long enough to catch diurnal effects.
tran: +1. thanks everyone.
